'''Sonny''' is a deceased shopkeeper in [[Freeside]] {{In|FOTV}}.

==Background==
Sonny operated a store in Freeside called [[Sonny's Sundries]], which offered various goods including [[chems]] and weapons. Sometime around July 2296, he was robbed and murdered by a man named [[Shopkeep Simon|Simon]], who had came in naked. Simon subsequently dumped Sonny's body in a trash can in the back of his store and began wearing his clothes, though they were much too small for him; he was attempting to pass himself off as Sonny, raising the prices of all of the store's goods to exorbitant sums.

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The Wrangler]]===
[[Lucy MacLean]] is directed to Sonny's Sundries by [[the Ghoul]] in order to buy [[Addictol (TV series)|Addictol]] for her [[Buffout (TV series)|Buffout]] addiction. In the ensuing events, she ends up discovering Sonny's body, being confronted by Simon and figuring out what had happened, and ultimately shooting Simon in self-defense.

==Background==
Sorrel Booker is an old associate of [[the Ghoul]]. By [[Timeline (2250-2300)#2296|2296]], he became the self-proclaimed president of the "[[Govermint]]," with several [[Sheriff (TV series)|sheriffs]] as his subordinates, and with such businesses as the organ harvesters at the [[Super Duper Mart (TV series)|Super Duper Mart]] under his protection in [[Los Angeles]].<ref name="FalloutTV" />

==''Fallout'' TV series==

[[File:Cyst dish.png|thumb|250px|Sorrel Booker's cyst dish]]

Sorrel went on to detail a bit of the Ghoul's history as a famous [[Bounty Hunter]] to the sheriffs [[Troy (TV series)|Troy]] and [[Rex (TV series)|Rex]]. [[Vault-Tec Corporation]] (possibly) |role = |TV actor = }} The '''spectators'''{{Ref|(Note)}} are a group of [[Fallout TV series#Cast and characters|characters]] {{In|FOTV}}. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The Beginning]]=== Apparently associated with the [[Vault-Tec Corporation]], these people are seen observing the pre-[[Great War|War]] landmark meeting between Vault-Tec executives [[Barb Howard]] and [[Bud Askins]] along with other prominent corporate leaders, such as [[Robert House]], [[Frederick Sinclair]], [[Julia Masters]], and [[Leon Von Felden]], from a dark balcony above. Behind the spectators, [[man in shadows|another man]] stands alone in shadows in an observation room.''At the meeting, Barb checks her Pip-Boy. She looks up towards spectators watching from a dark balcony. Behind them, a man stands in shadows in an observation room.''
("[[The Beginning]]" audio description) ==Notes== {{Note|(Note)}} The characters' names and role are never stated in the show's [[Fallout TV series season 1|first season]].
